title: Update shared enum flags atomically
goal: Set or clear independent flags in one shared integer or enum without losing concurrent updates; use when each operation needs the prior value but no multi-field transaction.

sdk.reason: Build against .NET 11 references; exact RC2 pins record measured artifacts.
sdk.name: .NET SDK

language.reason: Canonical declared language mode; no preview syntax switch.
language.name: C#

packageAssets: Framework reference/runtime assemblies; no NuGet package route.
prerequisites: Console net11.0 project with nullable/implicit usings; no unsafe caller code.
Multithreaded runtime and supported integer or enum storage.
platforms: Ordinary multithreaded shared-framework runtime; Windows x64 CoreCLR executed, other platforms unverified.
stabilityLimitations: Actual RC2 verification, not final-GA proof; PIN-962 and PIN-959 remain open.
constraints: Only supported integer primitives or integer-backed enums; struct constraint does not permit arbitrary same-sized structs or floating-point values.
Atomicity is one location per call. Returned prior value is a snapshot; no multi-field transaction or progress/performance promise.
